Title: [Expense Claim] Submission fails when attaching a receipt
Preconditions: User is logged in and on the expense claim submission page. (assumed)
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Navigate to the Expense Claim module. (assumed)
2. Enter the required claim details. (assumed)
3. Attach a receipt file.
4. Click the submit button.
Expected Result: The claim should be submitted successfully with the attached receipt. (assumed)
Actual Result: The submission fails with a generic "something went wrong" message on the UI.
Error Details: POST /api/claims 500 Internal Server Error: {"error":"TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'size')"}
Possible Area: Backend/API: The 500 status code and TypeError regarding 'size' indicate the server is failing to process the uploaded file object.
Missing Info: Specific file format used (e.g., PDF, PNG), file size, browser version, and user account role.
